direct_recollection_2026_09_12.relative_sequence: After the Designia/Louise/Aabenraa internship corridor and after later moving into his own place, the Son attended Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov.

direct_recollection_2026_09_12.assistant_teacher_role: While enrolled as a student in the multimedia class, the Son often functioned as an informal assistant teacher during lessons. He voluntarily helped teach substantial portions of the class because his technical ability was ahead of the material being taught. He did not mind taking on that role.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.role_boundary: This was not a formal employment or teaching credential. The most accurate description is that he was a student who informally functioned as an assistant teacher inside the class.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.skills_context: This fits the broader chronology: prior IT work, Designia/mediegrafiker training, strong design/software performance and practical computer experience meant that parts of the multimedia curriculum were below his existing technical level.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.tree_sequence_relation: The 2011 Tree/psychiatric sequence happened after the Son had stopped attending Produktionsskolen.

public_historical_evidence.evidence: Historical listings identify the formal institution as Produktionsskolen På Sporet at Skolevej 34, 6640 Lunderskov.

A study of the Lunderskov production school describes it as originally created by Lunderskov Kommune, physically located in Lunderskov, serving under-25s without completed youth education through practical and theoretical workshop-based activity and production-school allowance.

A specialist Danish silver-makers registry associates the mark P.SP with Produktionsskolen På Sporet, Lunderskov, 2005–2008; a later PSV entry is associated with Produktionsskolen Vejen from 2010 onward.
public_historical_evidence.caution: This remains a dating clue rather than sufficient proof of the exact physical closure/move date.
